subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Jugglary".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Jugglary"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Juggling" which means the action of throwing and catching several objects simultaneously. (जादूगरी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was juggling three balls effortlessly at the circus.
 
 
 
• **"Juggling" **refers to the skill of keeping several objects in motion in the air by throwing and catching them. (जादूगरी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her juggling skills amazed the audience.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abhorrent** (घृणित): Inspiring disgust and loathing.
 
 
• **Example:** The idea of animal cruelty is abhorrent to many people.
 
 
 
• **Gesture** (इशारा): A movement of part of the body to express an idea or meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a gesture of apology by bowing her head.
 
 
 
• **Magnificence** (भव्यता): The quality of being magnificent or splendid.
 
 
• **Example:** The magnificence of the palace took our breath away.
